verdict.rationale: Jitsu is an event-data pipeline, so retention and deletion controls are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows no documented retention-period settings, data-deletion APIs, or per-user erasure capability. Filtering events before they land (Functions, unconnected sources) and self-hosting are adjacent controls over what gets collected and where it lives, not control over how long data is kept or how it is deleted.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
